import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_sf_bessel_J0(double x);
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J0.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J0.restype = ctypes.c_double

# Function to compute Bessel J0
def compute_bessel_j0(x):
    return gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J0(x)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: x = 5.0
    x = 5.0
    expected = -0.17759677131433830434739701
    result = compute_bessel_j0(x)
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-15, f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 2: x = 0.0
    x = 0.0
    expected = 1.0
    result = compute_bessel_j0(x)
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-15, f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 3: x = 10.0
    x = 10.0
    expected = -0.2459357644513483351977608621
    result = compute_bessel_j0(x)
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-15, f"Test case 3 failed: {result} != {expected}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
